decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir fits the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering business, so management has invested in it and committed to it, and one year of results is too short to stop justifying the launch.

The energy management system is a digital extension that has only been mentioned on the website, which signals weaker commitment, but management will likely attribute slow uptake to a temporary market ramp-up and keep it after the investment made.

The overflow flap gate has its own website page, a highly visible public commitment that is central to the firm's water-regulation direction, so management will persist with it even if early sales disappoint.
